name: nexus
description: Nexus: end-to-end encrypted notes and sync. This is the root of the workspace that holds the encryption, the merge, the server and the Obsidian plugin; the probe is standalone.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @nexus/crypto && npm run build --workspace nexus-obsidian
scripts.check: npm run build --workspace @nexus/crypto && npm run typecheck && npm run build --workspace nexus-obsidian && npm run test
